projects.title: Anime MCP
projects.summary: Building an MCP server for anime-character search, with a focus on retrieval quality and combining lexical and embedding scores.
projects.currentFocus: Identify retrieval bottlenecks and select embedding models for hybrid-fusion experiments.
projects.nextStep: Select the embedding models, run hybrid-fusion experiments, and compare the results with published findings.
projects.currentBlocker: The retrieval bottleneck has not yet been identified. Model selection and comparative experiments are needed to investigate it.

milestones.title: Develop the evaluation and lexical-retrieval foundation
milestones.description: Build the evaluation setup and lexical-retrieval baseline for comparing retrieval approaches.

milestones.title: Select embedding models
milestones.description: Model names and the final comparison set are pending.

milestones.title: Run hybrid-fusion experiments
milestones.description: Evaluate retrieval performance and investigate where bottlenecks appear.

milestones.title: Compare findings with published research
milestones.description: Examine whether the findings extend to anime retrieval and document differences supported by the experiments. Results are not yet available.

updates.text: The current priority is understanding retrieval bottlenecks and preparing an embedding-model comparison with hybrid fusion. Model selection and experimental results are pending.

links.label: Research reference: An Analysis of Fusion Functions for Hybrid Retrieval

projects.title: GBA-style personal website
projects.summary: A nearly finished personal website with a Game Boy Advance-style experience and A/B controls, running in the browser.
projects.currentFocus: Finish the remaining houses, correct character spawning, and improve the existing gameplay.
projects.nextStep: Add friends' houses, fix incorrect spawn locations, and refine the current gameplay.

milestones.title: Finish the browser-based website experience
milestones.description: The existing experience is nearly complete, with a small set of additions and fixes remaining.

milestones.title: Correct character spawn locations
milestones.description: Ensure characters do not appear at the wrong location.

updates.text: The website is nearly finished. Remaining work includes friends' houses, spawn-location fixes, and improvements to the current gameplay. The related browser game builds on this work.

projects.title: Browser game
projects.summary: A game growing out of the GBA-style website, with plans for expanded gameplay, NPC behavior, character classes, and offline play with local saves.
projects.currentFocus: Design the first version of NPC logic. Its actions are not currently organized as a state machine.
projects.nextStep: Continue developing the NPC logic independently before deciding on the broader implementation approach.

milestones.title: Design NPC logic v1
milestones.description: Initial action logic is being designed. The current version is not a state machine.

milestones.title: Develop expanded gameplay in TypeScript
milestones.description: Build on the website's browser-based foundation and GBA-style controls.

milestones.title: Enable offline play
milestones.description: The goal is a free game playable locally without a game server.

milestones.title: Add local saves and save-file import/export
milestones.description: Players should be able to keep their progress and load it again. The storage method and file format have not been selected.

updates.text: NPC logic design has started. The first version uses actions that are not yet a state machine. Offline play, character classes, expanded gameplay, and save-file import/export remain planned work.
